column1: # What this skill needs on the target machine at runtime, and how badly.
# The client helpers are pure bash plus POSIX coreutils and always work. A chat
# SERVER needs one of the runtimes below to open a listening socket, and the
# chain falls through in preference order:
# The four rows share one any-of group (fifth column), so the installer warns
# once when none of them resolves instead of once per missing tool. Without any
# of them chat-server.sh refuses with exit 69 and names the missing capability;
# send/read/tail against an existing log never needed a server and keep working.
